sites.name: Dasef Abremu, the Waiting Water (village)
sites.storm: storm-dusk at its worst: dust sheets and gusts; cloth and tarps flap (WPO); dust drifts on the lee side of walls; landmarks must read as silhouettes through 3 km transmittance ~0.15 haze
sites.story: B05 "We called this bend the Waiting Water..." (no water sound anywhere); B24 chorus
sites.style: BAZAAR STONE: terraced village of shared-wall rooms, market portico, lookout tower, dry channel and pool
sites.layout:
field terraces (dry-stone, along the contours, +7..+9 m)
                  lone room   [C1 L-room + store] tall house (gable)  --ramp--  TOWER yard (focal)
                 ramp--  [B1 P-room, hearth room, L-room]  [B2 store, L-hall]  -- lane B
      channel     lane A  [A1 L-room + store] [A2 L]   portico (3 arches), two awnings, well plaza
       (fall line)          plaza (packed earth, broken flags)   <- worn path from the road
  ============================ road (culvert parapets where the channel crosses) =========
           dry channel -> mill room + dead wheel -> the dry pool (cracked mud, stone lip)   (the hollow)
sites.notes: V2.1 (SETDRESS_V2.md). The tower is a lookout tower only, no religious dressing.

sites.name: Tfibaz Taflalut, the Numbered Stop (the Heron Pools caravanserai)
sites.storm: heavy, still, dusty air; low fog cards and heat shimmer at the platform and works; Geiger peak; the storm is worst here with the valley
sites.story: B08 (radio 2,480 m) "The new signs gave the places numbers... We called it the Heron Pools." The painted 6-8 board over the carved name is story set V5 (slot on the portal); CIN_P15_WORKS EXT frames the inn
sites.style: BAZAAR STONE: walled court inn, high blank outer wall, portal, arcade, back hall, corner tower; the dry Heron Pools in the hollow with a bund, a sluice, a quay and a hoist
sites.layout:
